reason: Trust fund page and the May 19, 2026 staff report match awards, terms and closed status.

set.typical_award_size: Implements Government Code 65915 for projects of five or more units: 10% lower income, 5% very low income, 10% moderate income (for-sale), 50% senior, 50% workforce housing (60% to 150% AMI, a local category with a 20% bonus, at least 50% of adult tenants working in the county and 25% of units at 60% to 80% AMI), 10% transitional foster youth, disabled veteran or homeless units (35% bonus), or 100% affordable projects. Bonus and incentive tables track state law; 100% lower income projects (up to 20% moderate) get an 80% bonus and four incentives, and within one-half mile of a major transit stop get no maximum density plus up to three additional stories or 33 feet. Senior developments get 20%, with a separate local senior amenity table. Parking ratios reduced per state law. Additional bonus and incentive provisions for transitional and supportive housing are in the Section governing those uses.
set.audit_note: Tier 4 spot check Nov 9, 2026: Section 12.03.160 (2025 republication) gives no maximum density near major transit for 100% affordable projects; the record said up to 80%. Prevailing wage false is uncited.

reason: Material: typical_award_size understated the 100% affordable transit bonus (no maximum density, not 80%).
